about.heading: The Best Weed Dispensary in Charlotte, Michigan
about.md:
High Society Cannabis in Charlotte is a premier vertically integrated cannabis dispensary, recognized for exceptional customer service and an extensive selection of premium cannabis products. By overseeing every stage of the cannabis process—from cultivation to retail—High Society guarantees the highest standards of quality and consistency.

Our dispensary offerings include top brands such as 710 Labs, Bloom, Camino, and Drip, celebrated for their quality and potency. This dedication to excellence has established High Society Cannabis as a trusted destination for premium cannabis in Charlotte.

items.label: Order online for pickup; curbside customers get a text when the order is ready

items.title: Who Can Shop
items.md: Recreational cannabis shopping is available for individuals aged 21 or older.

items.title: Check In
items.md: Upon arrival, present a government-issued ID or passport and check in with the security and front desk staff.

items.title: Stay in the Loop
items.md: Share your phone number and email to stay informed about exclusive deals and discounts.

items.title: Meet Your Budtender
items.md: When it’s your turn, a budtender will call you from the waiting area to assist with product selection and answer any questions, whether you’re a new visitor or a returning customer.

items.title: Choose Your Items
items.md: Once you’ve chosen your items, the budtender will notify the order preparation team. Payments can be made using cash, credit, or debit cards.

items.title: Complete Your Purchase
items.md: When your order is ready, a staff member will call your name, process your payment, and confirm the details to ensure everything is accurate before completing your purchase.

blocks.heading: How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

items.title: Browse the Menu
items.md: Browse our [Charlotte dispensary menu](/shop/charlotte/) online or contact us at [(517) 786-3002](tel:+15177863002) if you need assistance.

items.title: Build Your Order
items.md: Select your preferred products, set the quantities, add them to your cart, and schedule a convenient pick-up time.

items.title: Check Out
items.md: Complete your order by entering your details. First-time visitors must present a valid ID for verification, while returning customers can log in for faster checkout.

items.title: Curbside Pickup
items.md: Interested in curbside pickup? Let us know, and we’ll notify you via text when your order is ready for collection. Specify if you prefer curbside pickup, and you will receive a notification via text message when your order is ready for collection.

items.title: Enjoy Responsibly
items.md: Enjoy cannabis responsibly. We’re dedicated to providing a seamless and hassle-free shopping experience!

blocks.heading: Deals

items.title: Concentrates

blocks.heading: What Our Customers Say About Us
blocks.lead: Google reviews from High Society customers across our Michigan stores.

items.q: What are the requirements to shop at High Society Cannabis Charlotte?
items.a: To shop at our dispensary, you must present a valid government-issued ID verifying you are 21 or older. Individuals aged 18 and up with a valid medical marijuana card are also eligible to make purchases.

items.q: What should I do if I receive a defective product?
items.a: If you experience an issue with a product’s quality or functionality, please contact us at [(517) 786-3002](tel:+15177863002) or visit the store where the purchase was made. Our team is ready to assist.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept at your dispensary?
items.a: We accept cash and debit payments. Some locations may also accept mobile payment options. For added convenience, we also have an ATM available in-store. Please check with your nearest location for further details.

items.q: Is it legal to transport cannabis?
items.a: Cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan; however, transporting cannabis across state lines is prohibited under federal law. Please avoid taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What products are available at the dispensary?
items.a: Our dispensary offers a wide selection of premium cannabis products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Check out our menu or contact us with specific questions.

items.q: Do you have a loyalty program for customers?
items.a: Yes, High Society offers a loyalty program called The Society, where customers earn points for purchases. Redeem your points for discounts and special offers—ask our staff for details.
